input_oneliner: 66M DM2 CKD3, in for cellulitis, 30 min substernal pressure at rest, diaphoretic, BP 150/90, HR 92, sat 96%

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about radiation to arm(s) or jaw, similarity to prior angina, exertional vs rest onset, and associated nausea or diaphoresis
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Ischemic pain-character history: radiation to both arms and similarity to prior ischemia raise likelihood of MI
Pulse deficit is the key bedside dissection finding

reference_targets_freetext.item: Blood pressure differential between arms (>20 mmHg)

reference_targets_freetext.rationale: S3 modestly raises likelihood of MI and marks high-risk ACS
Crackles mark heart failure complicating ischemia

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about abrupt tearing pain radiating to the back
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Tearing/abrupt maximal pain is the history item for dissection

reference_targets_freetext.item: Palpate the chest wall for fully reproducible tenderness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Reproducible tenderness lowers but does not exclude ACS

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about pleuritic or positional quality and relation to meals or swallowing

should_not_recommend: Use relief with a GI cocktail or nitroglycerin as a diagnostic test
Exclude ACS on the basis of reproducible chest-wall tenderness
Wait for troponin before a focused examination and ECG

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: pain quality: substernal pressure -> tearing pain radiating to the back
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 66M DM2 CKD3, in for cellulitis, 30 min tearing pain radiating to the back at rest, diaphoretic, BP 150/90, HR 92, sat 96%
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Radial/femoral pulse deficit remains must_have and Blood pressure differential between arms becomes must_have; aortic dissection tops the differential; Ask about abrupt tearing pain is answered by the one-liner and drops; ask about focal neurologic symptoms or limb ischemia is a new item; ischemic pain-character history remains included.
